accessNotes: The given PDF URL (/assets/download/...) now returns 404 and /general_guidance is gone; the guidance page links the current PDF at /download/UNHCR_Data_Visualization_Guidelines.pdf (June 2025 edition, 32 pages), which was downloaded and fully extracted with pypdf; key pages rendered with Ghostscript. Exact ggplot defaults were read from unhcrthemes theme_unhcr.R on GitHub. Print sizes are in pt (px values below = pt x 1.333; the guide says sizes 'can be adjusted proportionally ... for web-based outputs').
summary: Humanitarian-agency report/web charts built on the UNHCR brand: Lato, UNHCR blue #0072BC as the predominant data colour, a bold black sentence-case title with ' | period' appended, legend and horizontal y-axis title at top-left, light grey gridlines, a black baseline, and a two-line grey footer 'Source: ...' + '© UNHCR, The UN Refugee Agency'. Strong rules for fixed category colours (regions, population types, gender) and either gridlines or data labels, never both.

colors.categoricalNotes: Data colours: Blue #0072BC (primary, 'should be the predominant colour in all UNHCR visuals'), Yellow #FFC740, Green #32C189, Cyan #6CD8FD, Red #D25A45, Purple #A097E3, Brown #7C3C36, Grey #BFBFBF (neutral). Max six categories per chart. Recommended combinations: 2 = Blue+Red / Blue+Cyan / Blue+Grey / Blue+Yellow; 3 = Blue,Yellow,Green / Blue,Yellow,Cyan; 4 = Blue,Yellow,Green,Cyan / Blue,Yellow,Cyan,Red; 5 = Blue,Yellow,Green,Cyan,Red / Blue,Yellow,Cyan,Purple,Brown; 6 = Blue,Yellow,Green,Cyan,Red,Purple / Blue,Yellow,Green,Red,Purple,Brown. Special fixed palettes: Regions - Asia & Pacific Green, East & Horn of Africa & Great Lakes Blue, Americas Purple, West & Central Africa Cyan, MENA Red, Europe Yellow. Population type - Refugees Blue, IDPs Green, Asylum-seekers Cyan, Other people in need of international protection Red, UNRWA refugees / Returned refugees & IDPs Purple, Stateless Yellow, Others of concern Grey. Gender - Male Blue, Female Green, Neutral/Non-binary Cyan. Single category (e.g. only IDPs): default UNHCR blue or a tonal variation.

axisTitle.placement: y-axis title horizontal at top-left above the axis (recommended); rotated alongside axis is the alternative; x-axis title centred below

source.style: regular, 'Source: ...' then '© UNHCR, The UN Refugee Agency' on the next line

typography.notes: Print spec (pt): figure number Regular 9pt UNHCR blue; title Bold 12pt black; subtitle Regular 9pt 85% black; legend Regular 8pt 85%; y-axis title Regular 8pt 55%; x-axis title Regular 8pt 55%; axis labels Regular 8pt 85%; data labels Regular 8pt 85% (dark) or white on dark fills; note Regular 7pt 85%; source Regular 7pt 55%; copyright Regular 7pt 55%. Lato chosen for 'high legibility of numbers'. unhcrthemes: base 12, title rel 1.35 #000000, subtitle 12, caption rel 0.7 #737373, axis/legend text rel 0.9 #262626, axis titles #737373. Title and subtitle: sentence case ('first word capitalized').

structure.gridlines: 0.5pt lines in 25% black (#BFBFBF), along the value axis only (horizontal for column/line, vertical for bar charts); omitted when data labels are used.
structure.axisLine: Baseline axis 0.75pt solid black (x-axis on column/line charts; the category axis line on bar charts).
structure.ticks: None (unhcrthemes axis_ticks = FALSE); guide mock-ups show small ticks only on the category baseline.
structure.yAxisTitle: Horizontal, top-left above the y-axis labels, 55% grey, sentence case with unit in parentheses ('Number of people (million)'); rotated is the alternative position
structure.unitPlacement: In the y-axis title in parentheses, e.g. 'USD millions', 'Number of people (thousand)'.
structure.frame: No border; optional 'top bar' - a 0.5pt UNHCR blue rule across the top of the chart.
structure.notes: unhcrthemes: theme_minimal base, plot margins = font size (12pt) all round, title/caption positioned to whole plot, legend at top justified left.

legend.placement: top, left-aligned, between subtitle and y-axis title
legend.directLabels: Preferred on line charts: series names at line ends in the series' AAA text colour (e.g. 'IDPs', 'Refugees'); legend omitted.
legend.title: none

marks.bars: Solid UNHCR blue bars, no outline, square corners; bar thickness about 2-3x the gap; sorted descending (largest at top) in bar charts; stacked bars with white data labels inside dark segments.
marks.lines: Medium-weight solid lines (~2px), no markers, direct end labels in series colour.
marks.areas: Stacked areas, fully opaque, in category colour order (blue, yellow, green, cyan).
marks.pies: Pie and donut allowed for part-to-whole (e.g. funding received vs gap with large centre total); labels with percentages next to slices.
marks.notes: Line-column (dual-axis) chart and population pyramid shown as accepted UNHCR formats.

labels.dataLabels: Either data labels or axis labels/gridlines - 'we should never use axis labels/gridlines together with data labels'. Data labels 8pt dark grey (#262626) on light backgrounds/outside bars, white inside dark bars; bar-chart labels just beyond the bar end.
labels.numberFormat: Decimal values with fixed decimals (6.69, 0.52); thousands with comma (1,000); currency '$144 M'; percentages '22%'.
labels.dates: Period appended to title after a pipe: 'Title | 2010-2020'; months abbreviated (Jan, Feb).
labels.notes: Note line prefixed 'Note:' (e.g. 'figures do not add up to 100 per cent due to rounding').

furniture.title: Short, sentence case, bold black, left-aligned, with the time period after a vertical bar ('People displaced across borders by country of origin | 2020'). Optional subtitle (also short, sentence case). Optional 'Figure 1' label above the title in UNHCR blue.
furniture.source: Bottom-left: optional 'Note: ...' line, then 'Source: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder', then '© UNHCR, The UN Refugee Agency' (copyright recommended for web-based charts), all 7pt; source and copyright in 55% grey.
furniture.logo: No logo image; brand attribution via the '© UNHCR, The UN Refugee Agency' line.
furniture.other: Optional top bar: 0.5pt UNHCR-blue horizontal rule above the figure number/title.

annotations: Direct labels at line ends in the AAA-contrast version of the series colour.
layout: Elements placed and aligned to a common left edge as in the anatomy mock-up; sizes given for print and scaled proportionally for web.
accessibility: Data palette selected for accessibility; AAA-compliant text colours provided for every category colour; limit to six categories; never combine gridlines/axis labels with data labels to avoid congestion.

discouraged: more than six categories (except UNHCR special category palettes)
chartTypes.notes: Chart-type catalogue organised by change over time, correlation, comparison, distribution, part-to-a-whole, ranking, flow, geospatial.

distinctiveRules.rule: UNHCR blue #0072BC is the predominant data colour; single-category charts use only blue or a tonal variation.
distinctiveRules.quote: The blue colour is the primary colour and should be the predominant colour in all UNHCR visuals.

distinctiveRules.rule: Title bold, black, sentence case, left-aligned, with period after a pipe: 'Title | 2010-2020'.
distinctiveRules.quote: Title should be short with the first word capitalized | 2010-2020

distinctiveRules.rule: Footer of two left-aligned grey 7pt lines: 'Source: ...' and '© UNHCR, The UN Refugee Agency'.
distinctiveRules.quote: Source: here is the data source / © UNHCR, The UN Refugee Agency ... Copyright recommended for web-based charts

distinctiveRules.rule: Y-axis title placed horizontally at top-left above the axis in 55% grey with unit in parentheses (rotated only as an alternative).
distinctiveRules.quote: Y-axis title (unit) ... recommended position / alternative position

distinctiveRules.rule: Legend at top-left (below subtitle), no title, small square swatches.
Never show gridlines/axis labels together with data labels - pick one.
distinctiveRules.quote: we should never use axis labels/gridlines together with data labels

distinctiveRules.rule: Gridlines 0.5pt #BFBFBF along the value axis only; baseline axis 0.75pt black; no ticks.
distinctiveRules.quote: Gridline 0.5 pt, CMYK: 0/0/0/25 ... Axis 0.75 pt, CMYK: 0/0/0/100

distinctiveRules.rule: Data labels dark grey (#262626) on light backgrounds, white inside dark bars.
distinctiveRules.quote: Data labels have two colours: white (0/0/0/0) and dark gray (0/0/0/85).

distinctiveRules.rule: Fixed semantic colours for UNHCR categories: Refugees blue, IDPs green, Asylum-seekers cyan, Stateless yellow, Others of concern grey; regions and gender also have assigned colours.
distinctiveRules.quote: certain category groupings are consistently represented using specific, predefined colour palettes

distinctiveRules.rule: Maximum six categories per chart; recommended category combinations always start with blue then yellow.
distinctiveRules.quote: it is recommended not to use more than six categories in a single chart

distinctiveRules.rule: Line charts direct-label series at line ends in the series' AAA text colour instead of a legend.
distinctiveRules.quote: Line chart example labels 'IDPs' and 'Refugees' at line ends; AAA-compliant text for all categorical colours

distinctiveRules.rule: Optional 'Figure N' label (9pt UNHCR blue) above the title and optional 0.5pt blue top bar.
distinctiveRules.quote: Figure number Regular, 9 pt, CMYK: 99/50/0/0 ... Top bar 0.5 pt, CMYK: 99/50/0/0

distinctiveRules.rule: Lato for all chart text; diverging scales centre on #F5F5F5.
distinctiveRules.quote: For data visualizations, we recommend using Lato due to the high legibility of numbers

referenceImages.describes: Annotated anatomy: thin blue top bar; 'Figure 1' in small blue text; bold black title 'Title should be short with the first word capitalized | 2010-2020'; regular subtitle; legend at top-left with blue and light-cyan squares ('Set 1', 'Set 2'); small grey 'Y-axis title (unit)' horizontal above the y labels at top-left; light grey horizontal gridlines; stacked columns in UNHCR blue and cyan with white labels inside blue segments and dark labels in cyan; black baseline with years below; grey centred x-axis title; bottom-left 'Note:', 'Source:' and '© UNHCR, The UN Refugee Agency' lines in small grey Lato.

Two horizontal bar charts, 'People displaced across borders by country of origin | 2020' (bold black title, left). Left: blue bars sorted descending, category labels right-aligned left of a black vertical baseline, light grey vertical gridlines, x labels 0-7 at bottom, grey x-axis title 'Number of people (million)'. Right: same bars with 2-decimal data labels just past bar ends, no gridlines and no value axis, unit as a grey subtitle line. Both with grey 'Source: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder' and '© UNHCR, The UN Refugee Agency' bottom-left.

Stacked area chart (blue, yellow, green, cyan opaque layers) with legend of small squares at top-left and 'USD millions' grey y title above the axis; light grey horizontal gridlines; black baseline; month labels. Line chart with blue (Refugees) and green (IDPs) ~2px lines, no markers, direct labels at line ends in darker series colours, horizontal grey y title 'Number of people (million)' top-left; source and copyright lines bottom-left.
